name: nGZSceneGraph::cTransformNode::Create
notes: Lane OB. Hooked: the factory is the switch; every node it makes is ours (our vtables and template bodies, sg/SGNodeTemplates.h, gz/cAbstractBehaviorTypeST.h). SG_TransformNode_Factory / _Slots / _Persist / _Clone / _Events (tests/sg_transform_pilot.h): each side builds its trees with its own factory (the original 0xa3a6c0, ours Create) and drives them through every slot (the composition ones, the attributes 7 and 10, the transforms 53-65, the traversal's slot 5) and the +8 persist face, with real nodes so the tree code (propagation, flag 12 cache refresh) runs on both sides; compared: the calls on the fakes, the notes, every node's words but its two vtable words, the blocks freed. The tests place the tree code's statics (event registry 0x2640f0 and the refresh's table at 0x10f5fa0, tests/sg_transform_pilot.h RefreshScope). The class's own slot bodies (the deleting destructor and Release thunks, Clone 0xa3b700 -> CloneInto 0xa3ae50, the template bodies 0xa3aee0, 0xa3a790, 0xa3b0b0, 0xa3a680, 0xa3a4a0, 0xa3a540, 0xa3a1f0, 0xa3a3b0, 0xa3b250, 0xa3af20, 0xa3b210, 0xa3b240, 0xa3b220, 0xa3a730, 0xa3aec0, 0xa3aed0, 0xa3aea0, 0xa3aeb0, 0xa3b130, 0xa3b190, 0xa3b180, 0xa3b1d0, 0xa3b140 behind its vtables 0xe692ac / 0xe693bc, and the shared_vf bodies they share with the composition and bounded families: the composition ones listed on cCompositionTreeNode::Create) stay unhooked: the game's constructor 0xa39fa0 / 0xa3a000 still builds nodes for any caller of the template and most of those bodies are folded across the node family. Slots 43 / 44 / 51 call the Impl's iterator builders, ours (0xa37fd0 / 0xa37e40: lane OP, SG_TreeIterators; 0xa37d80: lane OM); the pilot tests do not call those slots. The refresh 0xa39b70 is ours since lane OP (the original side still needs the game's statics). The constructor sets flag 0 (the base of the family's constructors: found by the first run, flags differed). Mutants (tools/mutate.py --force-filter, because the mutated bodies are template bodies in sg/SGNodeTemplates.h that no test statically reaches): the pilot list of 55 over both pilots and the templates, 55 killed (one slot-73 survivor killed after op 22 learned to stale the cached transform first).

name: nGZSceneGraph::cTransformNodeBehaviorTraits::RegistryFor (the transform family's event registry)
notes: Lane SM (H1b part 9). Hooked (cdecl, 32-byte CRC site). A function-local static map built on first use and returned from every call, `attribute` stored under `id` first when id is not 0: a copy of the node registry (0x25efe0) plus the events 0xc9de8b96 (0xff838c), 0x9b59fb00 (0xff83d4), 0xfb5b3383 (0xff83a4) and 0x9b5b3506 (0xff83bc). SG_TransformNode_Registry: 600 seeds of 1-6 calls (ids from a fixed pool plus random, random records), against the original started from the state its first-use build leaves (the parents' maps and this map placed at their statics with the guards and once bytes marked done, the holder's registrations then run through the real registry; ours starts from nothing); after every call the returned map's identity and every record (key, id, name, three words, last) of this map, its parent and the base registry are compared. Mutants: record swapped, id store skipped, parent copy skipped, each killed.

name: nGZSceneGraph::cTransformNodeBehaviorTraits registry holder (once-byte step)
notes: Lane SM. The registry's holder (run on every call of 0x2640f0, a once byte skipping it after the first): makes a small object kept in a static (read by nothing) and runs 0x257110 (0x257030's events, then the four transform events through 0x2640f0). Folded into RegistryFor as the first-use build (0x257110's work); SG_TransformNode_Registry plants the original's state from it and compares what ours builds. Its only caller is the hooked 0x2640f0.
